description: TGWAB dependency updates for pnpm repos — DEV-STANDARDS §15. Place at renovate.json.
Renovate rather than Dependabot because Dependabot supports pnpm v7-v10 only and opens zero PRs on a pnpm 11 lockfile.
constraints.pnpm MUST equal the root package.json packageManager pin — without it Renovate's lockfile step can fall back to whatever pnpm@latest resolves to.
config:best-practices supplies helpers:pinGitHubActionDigests, which is what makes the §15 pin-actions-to-SHA rule sustainable.
